tasks.title: Create and verify the foundation scaffold
Atomic transitions, event log, and config discovery
Deterministic planning contracts and approval gate
Architect prompt and structured response orchestration
Model-runner factory, role routing, and adapter reliability
Harness adapters: Codex CLI and Claude Code
Doctor authentication checks and plan-command runner wiring
Execution contracts, durable attempts, and dependency scheduler
Bounded worker prompt, workspace execution, and evidence
Concurrent run orchestration, resume, and Phase 4 gate

handoff.summary: P04-T03 is complete after bounded implementation, adversarial repair, and independent QA acceptance. DraftForge now preflights workspace-capable worker routes before claim, builds boundary-checked least-context prompts, invokes local harnesses once in deterministic worktrees, validates strict result envelopes, persists redacted evidence before transition, and advances workers only to review or blocked. Authoritative Git inspection now distrusts mutable index, exclusion, history, filter, hook, stat, line-ending, and worktree controls; tracked submodules fail closed, while uncertain process termination preserves the active attempt for explicit resume. Typecheck, lint, all 211 tests (206 pass, 5 expected skips), session check, and build pass. P04-T04 is ready.
decisionsLocked: Use strict TypeScript, Node.js, npm, and ESM.
Route architect, worker, and reviewer roles through provider adapters with configurable model IDs.
Use .draftforge/state.json as canonical state and generate SESSION.md from it.
Use DAG task contracts, isolated workers, and independent review before completion.
Serialize task transitions with a project lock and append redacted events before atomic snapshot writes.
Apply optional config.local.json as a deep override, then validate the merged configuration.
Store resumable interview drafts and revision-bound approval in .draftforge/planning.json while keeping runnable task state authoritative in .draftforge/state.json.
Materialize approved phase, ADR, and task files before making active-phase roots ready.
Accept exactly one architect envelope per turn and derive the expected kind from planning state.
Parse raw model text in src/application/ and validate it before it reaches domain state.
Drive planning through plan --prompt, --submit, and --answer until Phase 3 adapters exist.
Change an approved plan only through a recorded revision that carries answers forward and preserves recorded progress.
Retain one superseded plan so re-materialization can tell generated files from user edits.

Decompose Phase 3 by transport: shared runner/reliability foundation (P03-T01), harness adapters (P03-T02), API adapters (P03-T03), then doctor auth and plan wiring (P03-T04), with every adapter passing one reusable contract-test suite.
Adapters map transport failures to AdapterError with a correct retryable flag; the runner centralizes timeout, retry, and redaction so authentication and contract errors are never retried.
Codex CLI and Claude Code share an injectable shell-free child-process transport; prompts use stdin, provider-default omits the model flag, and explicit models are forwarded.

OpenAI and Anthropic share an injectable fetch transport (no vendor SDK); keys come from the environment only, provider-default resolves to a default model constant in the provider layer, and HTTP 401/403 are terminal while 429 and 5xx are transient.
The live API smoke tests require both the provider key and DRAFTFORGE_LIVE_SMOKE=1 so a routine npm run check never issues a paid request by surprise.
Drive one provider-backed architect turn with plan --run; keep plan --prompt and plan --submit as unchanged manual checkpoints.
Doctor checks only configured role adapters, caches duplicate routes, treats absent authentication as missing, and never surfaces environment values or subprocess output.

On Windows, preserve where.exe PATH order, ignore unsupported extensionless aliases, spawn executables directly, and invoke npm-style .cmd/.bat shims through an escaped cmd.exe boundary while prompts remain on stdin.

Represent every worker dispatch with a stable attempt reference in canonical task state and a schema-validated manifest under .draftforge/runs; claim under the project lock, then release it before workspace or model side effects.
Treat workflow.currentTask as a display pointer only; task statuses and attempt references are the authoritative set of concurrent work.

Use the task file referenced by canonical state as the execution contract, record its hash per attempt, normalize segment-aware path ownership, and reserve canonical state, SESSION.md, and run-control artifacts to the scheduler.
Create deterministic Git worktrees under the run directory, preserve uncertain work, and resume the same attempt/worktree instead of transparently retrying a side-effecting worker call.
Phase 4 workspace mutation is available only through workspace-capable local harness adapters; text-only API worker routes fail before claim until a separate patch/tool protocol is designed.
Worker success advances only to review. Independent acceptance, repairs, merges, rollback, secret scanning, and usage accounting remain Phase 5.

Decompose Phase 4 by concern: execution contracts and scheduling (P04-T01) plus Git workspace isolation (P04-T02) can proceed in parallel; worker execution/evidence (P04-T03) joins them; run/resume and the exit gate finish in P04-T04.

Treat every worker-mutable Git control surface as untrusted during inspection: use fixed safe command overrides, reject executable filters and tracked submodules, and preserve any workspace whose authoritative scope cannot be proven.
nextActions: Execute P04-T04 through a bounded code-builder: wire concurrent run/resume orchestration, reconcile durable crash points, and expose actionable CLI outcomes.
Run the deterministic Phase 4 sample gate through the built CLI, then update canonical state and SESSION.md only after independent QA accepts the implementation.
gotchas: Workspace scope enforcement must stay content-derived: tracked changes come from a scratch index (no stat cache) unioned with a `--cached` diff. Reverting to a plain `git diff <base>` silently reopens a Windows hole where a same-size, restored-mtime rewrite is invisible; test/workspaces/git.test.ts guards it.
Changed paths now include a staged change whose worktree edit was reverted. This over-reporting is deliberate and safe; do not 'fix' it by dropping the `--cached` diff.

P04-T01..T03 were recorded as done with a fully green run, but that same commit failed 7 tests on this Windows machine (symlink EPERM without Developer Mode, Git 2.54 fsmonitor behavior, and one real defect). Treat recorded green evidence as environment-specific unless re-run locally.
`templates/schema/*.json` must stay byte-identical to `.draftforge/schema/*.json`; test/templates.test.ts enforces it.
P04-T01 adds a shipped execution schema and changes state/planning contracts; runtime validators, migrations, fixtures, and template copies must move together.
P04-T01 and P04-T02 are intentionally path-disjoint and ready together. Canonical state, SESSION.md, and `.draftforge/runs/` are lead/scheduler control paths, not worker-owned paths.
A worker model call can mutate its worktree, so provider-level transparent retry must be disabled for that call; timeout or transient failure is resumed explicitly against the same attempt.
Phase 4 must not mark worker output done. Its dependency test may simulate a trusted reviewer transition, but real reviewer execution starts in Phase 5.
API adapters remain usable for text-only roles, but Phase 4 run/resume must reject an API-backed worker route before claiming work because no safe patch/tool protocol exists yet.
The default model IDs live in `src/providers/api/openai-api.ts` and `anthropic-api.ts` (DEFAULT_MODEL); update them there when a provider's default moves — config and domain must not pin a model ID.

Codex CLI, Claude Code, and provider API keys were not detected in this shell; provider live smoke tests require DRAFTFORGE_LIVE_SMOKE=1 plus the corresponding available authentication and otherwise skip.
Windows npm-installed harnesses may resolve through .cmd shims; keep process invocation escaping and PATH-order regression tests intact.
Generated `.draftforge/runs/` events are ignored run artifacts and must not be staged.

Worker Git inspection fails closed for executable clean/process filters, mutable fsmonitor or hook configuration, unsafe index/history/exclusion controls, tracked submodules, and local/worktree line-ending normalization overrides; P04-T04 CLI documentation must surface these limitations actionably.
A timeout whose child or descendants are not definitely terminated records the PID but leaves the task active and skips workspace inspection; resume must prove process absence before reuse.
An approved plan is still immutable in place: plan --submit and plan --prompt refuse it until `plan --revise` starts a recorded revision.
The architect prompt text is asserted in test/architect.test.ts; changing wording means updating those assertions.
If a process crashes during the brief stale-lock recovery claim, verify no DraftForge process is running before removing `.draftforge/state.lock.recovery`.
The workspace is OneDrive-backed, so large file operations can be slower than normal.
